noAnchorGaps.concept: The candle is taught as stabbing below support and closing back above 'the level' — that horizontal support line is the reference the wick pierces and the body reclaims, but the bullish_sweep candle move exposes no horizontal-level anchor to draw it.
noAnchorGaps.quote: a long lower wick that stabs below support and snaps back ... a decisive close back above the level
noAnchorGaps.why: move bullish_sweep exposes only low(pt) and close(pt) — no (L) level anchor for the 'support'/'the level' line; cannot be drawn without inventing an anchor
